name: What is the typical cost range for door hinge repair in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for door hinge repair in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of door hinge repair in the Bay Area can vary significantly depending on the type of door, the extent of the damage, and whether it's a repair or a full replacement. Simple hinge tightening might be included in a broader service call, while repairing stripped screw holes or replacing multiple hinges could range from $75 to $200 per door. For custom or heavy-duty doors, costs may be higher due to specialized hardware or labor. It's best to get a specific quote after an assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Door hinge repair costs in the Bay Area vary; simple fixes might be part of a service call, while hinge replacement or complex repairs could range from $75-$200+ per door.
